name: Sweet Pumpkin Disease Recognition Dataset
description: The Sweet Pumpkin Disease Recognition Dataset is a specialized agricultural vision benchmark focused on Cucurbita moschata (sweet gourd/pumpkin), a vital nutritional and cash vegetable in Bangladesh. Collected directly from active agricultural fields, the dataset captures five major foliar health categories: Healthy Leaf, Downy Mildew Disease, Leaf Curl Disease, Mosaic Disease, and Red Beetle infestation damage. The foundational collection contains 1,000 raw field photographs, which were subsequently augmented via geometric shifting, horizontal/vertical flipping, scaling, shear, brightness adjustment, and rotation to produce a 7,000-image augmented suite (8,000 images total).
